titles.romaji: Lei Su Deng: Yi Fei Chong Tian

description: Hover Champs tells the story of some boys who compete in remote-controlled helicopters: Matthew and Zoe. Matthew is a 13-year-old boy who returns, with his mother, to the town where he was born. There he meets Zoe, a girl with great ability to drive remote-controlled helicopters. Matthew manages, on the first day, to break Zoe's record and she proposes that he form a team to compete together.
